translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

content: A nianga tupas no tunotuno nong i kure ira ut na ninge: ira bulumur ta Korah diet ga pit iakan ra ninge.

content.text: Hoing ra dia i taaba ra karamena pane ra taah saal,
huo mah, iau manga masingan pane ugu, God.
Iau maruk pane God, pane no lilona God.
Hunanges um iau ni haan ma ni harso mane God?
Ira polo na matagu i ngan bia agu nian
ra kasakes ma ra bung,
ma kana ira tunotuno diet tangtange tagu tano kudulena bung,
“Ie he um no num God?”
Iau lik kawase tar kaiken ra linge
ing iau tangtange hapuasne no balagu, ma i hoken.
Iau git hanahaan tika ma ira haleng.
Iau git lulue no hinahaan uram tano hala tane God
ma ra kunup na gungunuama ma ra pirhakasing
tika ma ira tamat na matanaiabar diet mangmangata haan ma ra kanakana.
Iau haianga habaling iau, “Wara bih no balagu i hung ma ra tapunuk?
Wara bih no nugu lilik pai sangeh?
Kis nanahai ta God,
kanong iau ni pirlat at baak ie,
no nugu Ut na Harhalon ma no
nugu God.”
No balagu i tapunuk,
io kaik, iau nigi lik leh ugu,
merau Ioridaan,
meram hono uluno no uladih Hermon ma mekaia hono uladih Misar.
No lamlamana i tataau no lamlamana
narako tano tabirana ira sirsiroka.
Ira num pakananoh ma ira tes i suarlup,
diet te rarapus naliu tagu.
Ra kasakes no Watong i la tultule no uno harmarsai.
Ra bung iau ni inge auno tiga ninge,
a sinasaring uram hono God tano nugu nilon.
Iau tange ta God no nugu Haatkis,
“Warah u gom luban iau?
Warah kaik iau nigi tur na sunuah
ta ira ngunngutaan diet ing diet malok tagu diet ga ubal iau me?”
Ira surugu i kilingane ra tamat na ngunngutaan saakit
ing diet ing diet malentakuane iau, diet tangtange haliare iau.
Diet tangtange tagu tano kudulena bung bakut bia,
“Ie he um no num God?
Iau haianga habaling iau, “Wara bih no balagu i hung ma ra tapunuk?
Wara bih no nugu lilik pai sangeh?
Kis nanahai ta God,
kanong iau ni pirlat at baak ie,
no nugu Ut na Harhalon ma no nugu God.”
